notes: The word battle is doing no combat work here - this is a social round-based challenge loop with a gathering lobby, which is Party & Casual, and the genre note that the lobby carries the genre applies directly. Shape is space-staged because the prompt teleports the two players out of the lobby into an arena, and the answers confirm a separate instanced arena per battle with several battles running at once, so P4 is stated rather than assumed and is not overridden. Kept the Minigame preset's teleporter-link and trigger-scoring for the first-to-three round scoring and added social-hub for the named lobby plus spawn-protected for the two symmetric duel positions; dropped the preset's spectator-zone because an instanced 1v1 arena never has eliminated players waiting. The neon club look and the roughly 10-player lobby come from the answers and are theme and scale rather than a second genre; without a user I read the emote shop as a lobby vendor counter, not an enterable building, so this stays off P3, and no option covers a shop so it has to ride along as lobby dressing.
